say:2:1810241001:0.text: Wait... is that Rande's soul? It must be!
say:2:1810241001:0.source_cn: 天哪……那是兰利的灵魂吗？一定是兰利吧！！

say:3:1810241002:1.text: They're together again! It's a happy ending!
say:3:1810241002:1.source_cn: 他们重逢了， 他们在一起了！是圆满结局！！

say:4:1810241003:0.text: The new ending is beautiful! Oh, Rande... This moved me to tears!
say:4:1810241003:0.source_cn: 改编得好棒，兰利也演得好好……我要哭了！

say:5:1810241004:0.text: The audience's thunderous applause and cheers wash over you, leaving you lightheaded.
say:5:1810241004:0.source_cn: 接连不断的掌声和欢呼从台下涌来，铺天盖地，让你不由得有...
say:5:1810241004:0.male: The audience's thunderous applause and cheers wash over you, leaving you lightheaded.
say:5:1810241004:0.female: The audience's thunderous applause and cheers wash over you, leaving you lightheaded.

say:6:1810241005:0.text: Is it because this is your first proper stage performance? If you were still human, you'd probably hear nothing but the pounding of your own heart.
say:6:1810241005:0.source_cn: 是因为你第一次站在万众瞩目的舞台上吗？如果没有变成亡灵...
say:6:1810241005:0.male: Is it because this is your first proper stage performance? If you were still human, you'd probably hear nothing but the pounding of your own heart.
say:6:1810241005:0.female: Is it because this is your first proper stage performance? If you were still human, you'd probably hear nothing but the pounding of your own heart.

say:7:1810241006:0.text: Fortunately, you spot a familiar face in the crowd. Her eyes brim with tears as she applauds you enthusiastically.
say:7:1810241006:0.source_cn: 幸好，台下还有一个熟悉的身影。她眼含热泪，拼命地为你鼓掌。
say:7:1810241006:0.male: Fortunately, you spot a familiar face in the crowd. Her eyes brim with tears as she applauds you enthusiastically.
say:7:1810241006:0.female: Fortunately, you spot a familiar face in the crowd. Her eyes brim with tears as she applauds you enthusiastically.

say:11:1810241008:0.text: Vivi's support helps you regain your composure.
say:11:1810241008:0.source_cn: 薇薇娅的鼓励让你的心情镇定了下来，晕眩感也渐渐消失。
say:11:1810241008:0.male: Vivi's support helps you regain your composure.
say:11:1810241008:0.female: Vivi's support helps you regain your composure.

say:12:1810241009:1.text: While the audience gradually settles down, Senea steps forward from your side.
say:12:1810241009:1.source_cn: 与此同时，掌声和欢呼也渐渐平息。站在你身旁的塞涅向前一步。
say:12:1810241009:1.male: While the audience gradually settles down, Senea steps forward from your side.
say:12:1810241009:1.female: While the audience gradually settles down, Senea steps forward from your side.

say:15:1810241010:1.text: It's wonderful to see all of you again.
say:15:1810241010:1.source_cn: 非常高兴……能够再次见到大家。

say:16:1810241011:0.text: Thank you for coming to this special show.
say:16:1810241011:0.source_cn: 感谢你们不远万里来到诺珐斯，只为观看这场特殊的《消逝之声》。

say:17:1810241012:0.text: The original ending of Lost Voice revolves around the idea that life is filled with regrets. Yet some regrets can be redeemed in ways we never expect.
say:17:1810241012:0.source_cn: 《消逝之声》曾经的主题是——生命总是充满遗憾。但幸运的...

say:18:1810241013:0.text: I hope you enjoy this new ending and see death in a new light.
say:18:1810241013:0.source_cn: 希望你们能喜欢今天这个新的结局，不要再为死亡感到悲伤。

say:19:1810241014:0.text: Remember... not even death can keep us apart.
say:19:1810241014:0.source_cn: 请记住……即便死亡，也不会让我们分离。
